summary.intent: Run a health check and stats review on the cipher-box GSD planning system, then commit a GSD framework update (v1.30.0) to GitHub.
summary.outcome: Health check passed cleanly, all 12 phases and 53 plans confirmed complete at 94% requirements. GSD v1.30.0 was committed and pushed, then statusline.js (nuked by the update) was restored from a prior commit and pushed as a follow-up fix.

repo: GSD framework updates repeatedly nuke .claude/hooks/statusline.js — this has happened at least twice (first fixed in commit 96a50cb37, again in this session).
The project is on branch docs/milestone-v1.1-completion with 375 commits over 72 days (started 2026-01-15).
Milestone v1.1 is fully complete: 12/12 phases, 53/53 plans, 62/66 requirements (4 requirements still outstanding).

code.finding: File is not tracked/protected by GSD framework updates and gets deleted each time GSD is updated. Must be manually restored.
Still correctly references statusline.js after the GSD update — only the hook file itself was lost, not the settings reference.

workflow: When applying GSD framework updates, always verify .claude/hooks/statusline.js still exists afterward.
git log --all -- <path> is the right approach to find a deleted file's history for restoration.

friction: .claude/hooks/statusline.js was silently deleted by the GSD framework update with no warning — required manual detection and restoration from git history.
This is a recurring issue (second occurrence), suggesting no structural fix has been applied to prevent it.
open_items: 4 requirements remain outstanding out of 66 — not addressed in this session.
The GSD update process should be patched to preserve or re-apply statusline.js so it isn't nuked on every update.
